verdict.rationale: Smooth's REST API lets an agent submit a task (smooth_client.run), poll task status/list tasks, cancel tasks, and send events, with docs explicitly describing polling as the primary mechanism (and webhooks mentioned as an alternative rejected in favor of polling for simplicity) — all without the caller managing a browser itself. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation of webhook support or polling reliability at scale, and no public OpenAPI spec was found to verify full REST contract.
